summary: This sermon walks through Revelation 8-11, explaining the seven trumpets as God's escalating warnings to an unrepentant world. Despite increasingly severe judgments, people refuse to turn from idolatry, yet God's patience has a limit and the time for repentance will close. The church is called to faithful witness rather than compromise with corrupt worldly systems.
key_points: The trumpets are warning shots showing God's restraint, destroying only one-third
Even after devastating plagues, people refuse to repent and cling to idols
The faithful sacrificial witness of the church, not punishment alone, softens hearts
The seventh trumpet closes the window for repentance and consolidates God's kingdom
Believers must examine where they've compromised with worldly values and repent now
big_idea: God's escalating judgments are merciful warnings calling us to repent before the time of grace closes, urging us to abandon our idols and compromises with the world while there is still time.
title: REVELATION: The Seven Trumpets
